provenance.execution: Original complete modeling body entered using its copied ABI prologue after the out-of-scope edition guard. Original source selector, flag accessors, dialog/document pointer assignment and registered-mode name search execute. Scene iteration/type queries, navigation/factory providers, source flag setter and UI activation are controlled adapters; actual UCRT wide-string comparison is rebound.
provenance.excluded: Edition/licensing guard was neither executed nor changed. Constructors and installed GUI are not executed.

enablement.execution: Complete original enablement callback with original source selector and flag accessors, actual UCRT name comparison, and controlled iterator/type-query/UI recorder interfaces.

limitations: Controlled scene iterator and type-query interfaces, not original native object constructors or installed GUI.
Modeling body requires a resolvable scan; null-source execution was not attempted.
No original ASCII import factory was executed.
The application still requires a fixed target when beginning a point-pair session; source-only admission and broader picking remain implementation gaps.
